source.locator: Section 5 unnumbered open problem, physical PDF page 16
source.condition_locator: Proposition 5.2 and condition (42), physical PDF page 14

claim.scope: arbitrary discrete finite-entropy random variables on arbitrary abelian groups
claim.limit: for each fixed finite D, f(C,D)->0 as C->0

optimal_modulus_extension.scope: same random-variable class as the main theorem
optimal_modulus_extension.fixed_D_rate: for every fixed D>0, M(C,D)=D/log(1/C)*(1+o(1)) as C->0
optimal_modulus_extension.upper_bound: M(C,D)<=min{1-exp(-D), D(x+1)/x^2} for C,D>0, x=2W_0(0.5*sqrt(D log 2/C))

verification.finite_probe_role: sanity check only, not a proof premise
